decisions.statement: The property respelled is named as the type it sits on and then the property.
A property name with no type is refused.
A star in place of the type names every type the file declares.
A star is asked for rather than fallen into.
A type that is a union or an intersection states every property its parts state.
A file declaring no type at all is refused.
A file whose types state that property nowhere is refused.
A type already stating the name asked for is refused.
A property declared outside the file as well is refused.
The bodies read are the bodies the world answers rather than the bodies on disk.

definition: one property a type declares spelled anew wherever the checker resolves to it
